```{r functions}
load_demuxlet <- function(path) {
  d <- read.delim(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  num_cols <- c("BEST.LLK", "NUM.READS", "NUM.SNPS", "NEXT.LLK",
                "DIFF.LLK.BEST.NEXT", "BEST.POSTERIOR", "SNG.POSTERIOR",
                "SNG.BEST.LLK", "SNG.NEXT.LLK", "SNG.ONLY.POSTERIOR",
                "DBL.BEST.LLK", "DIFF.LLK.SNG.DBL")
  num_cols <- intersect(num_cols, colnames(d))
  d[num_cols] <- lapply(d[num_cols], as.numeric)
  na.omit(d)
}

strip_suffix <- function(x) sub("-\\d+$", "", x)

read_counts <- function(matrix_dir, min_features = MIN_FEATURES) {
  mat <- Read10X(data.dir = matrix_dir)
  if (is.list(mat)) mat <- mat[[1]]
  colnames(mat) <- strip_suffix(colnames(mat))
  mat[, Matrix::colSums(mat > 0) >= min_features, drop = FALSE]
}

summarise_qc <- function(Condition, Replicate, demuxlet_path, matrix_dir) {

  # Load data
  dmx <- load_demuxlet(demuxlet_path)
  dmx$BARCODE <- strip_suffix(dmx$BARCODE)
  mat <- read_counts(matrix_dir)

  # Shared barcodes (QC-passing cells)
  shared <- intersect(dmx$BARCODE, colnames(mat))
  dmx <- dmx[dmx$BARCODE %in% shared, ]
  mat <- mat[, shared, drop = FALSE]

  # Calculate metrics
  total_reads <- sum(mat)
  total_umis  <- Matrix::colSums(mat)
  total_genes <- Matrix::rowSums(mat > 0)

  n_dmx <- nrow(dmx)
  n_sng <- sum(dmx$DROPLET.TYPE == "SNG")
  n_dbl <- sum(dmx$DROPLET.TYPE == "DBL")
  n_amb <- sum(dmx$DROPLET.TYPE == "AMB")

  # Catch any unexpected DROPLET.TYPE values
  if (n_sng + n_dbl + n_amb != n_dmx) {
    warning(Condition, ".", Replicate, ": droplet types don't sum to total — ",
            paste(names(table(dmx$DROPLET.TYPE)), table(dmx$DROPLET.TYPE),
                  sep = "=", collapse = ", "))
  }

  data.frame(
    Condition             = Condition,
    Replicate             = Replicate,
    N_cells_total         = ncol(mat),
    N_genes_detected      = nrow(mat),
    Total_reads           = format(total_reads, big.mark = ","),
    Mean_reads_per_cell   = round(mean(total_umis), 0),
    Median_reads_per_cell = round(median(total_umis), 0),
    Mean_genes_per_cell   = round(mean(total_genes), 0),
    Median_genes_per_cell = round(median(total_genes), 0),
    N_singlets_demuxlet   = n_sng,
    N_doublets_demuxlet   = n_dbl,
    N_ambiguous_demuxlet  = n_amb,
    Pct_singlets          = round(100 * n_sng / n_dmx, 1),
    Pct_doublets          = round(100 * n_dbl / n_dmx, 1),
    Pct_ambiguous         = round(100 * n_amb / n_dmx, 1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r compute}
summary_table <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(samples)), function(i) {
  do.call(summarise_qc, as.list(samples[i, ]))
}))

summary_table$Condition <- factor(summary_table$Condition, 
                                   levels = c("YPD", "Fluconazole", "Synthetic-complete"))
summary_table <- arrange(summary_table, Condition, Replicate)

#knitr::kable(summary_table, caption = "Summary of single-cell RNA-seq and demultiplexing statistics")
```

```{r save}
write.csv(summary_table, file.path(OUT_DIR, "Supplementary_Table_QC_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
